what: the Milky Way face-on; galactocentric kpc, Galactic Centre at the origin, Sun at (-8.15, 0); x toward the Sun is negative, y along l=90

bar.note: model: a bar ~10 kpc long at ~28 deg to the Sun-centre line (Wegg+ 2015)

arm_model: each arm: ln R = a + k * beta (beta = atan2(y, x) in degrees, unwrapped around the arm), measured over beta lo..hi; the lab extends it beyond that span as a fading model
